package: K01-T3 production worker entrypoint local acceptance

result.worker_process: separate Node/tsx process launching scripts/video-worker.ts; graceful SIGTERM observed after SUCCEEDED
result.pipeline: actual worker entrypoint, Prisma queue claim, FFmpeg 8.0.1, AWS SDK R2 client, OriginalsReader/HlsWriter, playlist verification and Prisma finalizer
result.object_storage: in-memory S3-shaped HTTP fixture bound to 127.0.0.1; test endpoint enabled only in NODE_ENV=test and restricted to loopback HTTP
result.worker_unit_guard: 2/2 PASS for loopback-only endpoint and production-mode refusal

assertions: The disposable database contained only the target eligible queued job before the worker started.
The actual worker process reached SUCCEEDED/DONE at 100 percent and emitted started/stopped lifecycle logs.
The database has exactly one active route and one READY SELF_HLS asset; the asset key uses the claimed attemptId.
The loopback store contains master and variant playlists, an fMP4 segment and poster; HlsWriter verified playlist references before finalization.
After SUCCEEDED, SIGTERM caused graceful worker shutdown; all fixture rows were removed.
limitations: Does not exercise Next.js upload or playback HTTP routes and is not a browser test.
The loopback S3-shaped fixture is not Cloudflare R2; provider durability, multipart semantics, ETag/CORS and edge playback remain unverified.
K01-T3 and K35 remain partial; real R2 acceptance and independent review remain open.
